Manifesto · Tecnologia e Humanidade — Al: Manifesto · Technology and Humanity — Alan Miranda
UM ALERTA SOBRE O FUTURO QUE ESTAMOS CON: A WARNING ABOUT THE FUTURE WE ARE BUILDING.
Tecnologia é irreversível. O modo como e: Technology is irreversible. How we choose to use it remains a human responsibility.
A automação, a inteligência artificial e: Automation, artificial intelligence and technology in general represent an irreversible transformation in human history. We are building systems increasingly capable of performing tasks, processing information, making decisions and replacing activities that, for centuries, depended entirely on human ability. I do not believe the way forward is to ignore this progress or try to stop it, but to reflect critically on its direction, its consequences and the boundaries we need to establish.
Minha visão pessoal é que o progresso te: My personal view is that technological progress does not necessarily mean human progress.
Acredito que o uso excessivo, indiscrimi: I believe that excessive, indiscriminate and unreflective use of these tools may contribute to weakening intellectual autonomy. When we delegate to machines not only operational tasks, but also the effort of thinking, questioning, interpreting and learning, we risk trading the development of our abilities for the convenience of receiving ready-made answers. Artificial intelligence can be a powerful learning tool, but it can also become an intellectual crutch when it systematically replaces the reasoning it should encourage.
Esse risco não se limita à inteligência: This risk is not limited to artificial intelligence. The constant presence of screens, hyperconnectivity, the continual search for stimulation and the logic of endless content consumption deserve attention. I believe these behaviors may contribute to difficulties with concentration, procrastination, anxiety, isolation and other harms to well-being, especially when boundaries, awareness of use or concern for their effects on physical and mental health are absent. The relationship between technology and human health is complex, however: effects vary with the tool, intensity of use, context and each person's characteristics.
Existe ainda uma preocupação que conside: There is another concern I consider essential: malicious use of these technologies. Systems created to make life easier can be used to manipulate behavior, spread misinformation, exploit vulnerabilities, expand fraud and concentrate power. The more capable a technology is, the greater the responsibility of those who develop, control and use it. Innovation without responsibility can turn tools of progress into instruments of exploitation.
É por essas razões que defendo uma posiç: For these reasons, I take a critical position on technological advancement. I am not against technology. I am against the idea that everything that can be developed must necessarily be developed, that all automation is beneficial, or that efficiency alone justifies any consequence.
Meu propósito ao estudar, pesquisar e de: My purpose in studying, researching and developing technology is to seek solutions that benefit humanity.
Quero explorar a inteligência artificial: I want to explore artificial intelligence, automation, robotics, computing systems and engineering to solve real problems, improve quality of life, increase safety, reduce risks, optimize resources and make complex activities more accessible and efficient. I also consider it important to investigate how these same technologies can help address the adverse effects of their own use, encouraging greater human autonomy, healthier relationships with digital media and applications that contribute to collective well-being.
Meu interesse não está restrito à capaci: My interest is not limited to making a machine perform a task. It also involves understanding whether that task produces a concrete benefit, respects the people involved, uses resources responsibly and contributes to a better future. Whether developing specialized intelligent agents, automating processes, analyzing marine systems or researching new engineering solutions, I believe human purpose must remain at the center of the project.
Acredito que precisamos desenvolver tecn: I believe we need to develop technologies that extend our abilities without eliminating our initiative; that make work easier without devaluing human knowledge; that automate processes without ignoring the people affected; and that advance without irresponsibly compromising the environment on which we depend.
A maior tecnologia existente continua se: The greatest technology remains humanity itself. And nature is one of the most extraordinary expressions of complexity, balance and life we know.
São elas que devemos preservar, compreen: These are what we must preserve, understand and care for. No computational advance replaces human dignity, no artificial intelligence fully reproduces the experience of being alive, and no innovation justifies treating the planet as an inexhaustible resource.
Por isso, enxergo a engenharia não apena: That is why I see engineering not only as the ability to design, calculate, build and optimize, but also as a commitment to assess consequences, recognize limits and take responsibility. Being an engineer means transforming possibilities into solutions, but also distinguishing what we can build from what is truly worth building.
O futuro não deve ser definido exclusiva: The future should not be defined exclusively by the abilities of machines, but by the human choices that guide their development.
O arquiteto é grande, o jardineiro é div: The architect is great, the gardener is divine, and the engineer has to be brilliant!
Genial não apenas para criar o que ainda: Brilliant not only in creating what does not yet exist, but in understanding the impact of those creations, preserving what has value and putting knowledge in service of life.
Este é o princípio que orienta minha vis: This is the principle that guides my view of technology, my research and the systems I intend to develop: innovate with purpose, build responsibly and keep humanity at the center of every solution.
Para continuar essa reflexão, recomendo: To continue this reflection, I recommend exploring books on habits, self-help, emotional intelligence and personal development. The library brings together books for discovering new perspectives and building more conscious practices.

ALPHA APP - sistema experimental de anál: ALPHA APP — an experimental analysis, modeling, calibration and backtesting system applied to Lotofácil.
Predictive Lottery Intelligence Engine:: Predictive Lottery Intelligence Engine: an experimental system for analysis, modeling, calibration, model combination and historical validation applied to Lotofácil.
O Alpha App apresenta um laboratório de: Alpha App is a laboratory for data engineering and predictive modeling. Its purpose is not to sell promises of winning, but to organize hypotheses, signals, metrics and experiments within a comparable architecture.
O sistema trabalha com dados históricos,: The system works with historical data, builds features, runs families of models, calibrates scores, combines signals and evaluates results through backtesting.
Observed data is not a prediction.
O projeto separa estatística descritiva,: The project separates descriptive statistics, signal generation, calibrated scores and final combinations to avoid confusing historical patterns with a guarantee of future results.
A leitura correta é experimental: cada s: The appropriate interpretation is experimental: every output must be compared, validated and interpreted within scientific limits.

As features transformam o histórico em r: Features turn historical data into computational representations. They feed the methods, but should not individually be interpreted as predictions.
Frequência, distribuição, recorrência e: Frequency, distribution, recurrence and statistical relationships.
Janelas, recência, dinâmica e mudanças r: Windows, recency, dynamics and recent changes in signals.

A janela avança ao longo do histórico pa: The window advances through the historical data to observe stability across different periods, reducing methodological shortcuts.
O M30 explora uma visão de pipeline neur: M30 explores a neural pipeline perspective: feature vector, normalization, representation layers, transformation and output score.
O M105 representa a linha experimental d: M105 represents an experimental approach to neural execution in a lightweight runtime, focusing on conversion, compatibility and local inference.
O ALPHA APP é um sistema experimental de: ALPHA APP is an experimental modeling and analysis system. Its methods produce scores and combinations based on statistical, temporal and computational patterns. This does not demonstrate an ability to predict a random process or guarantee future results. Backtesting measures historical behavior; it does not turn the system into a guarantee of winning.
